say:1:1623361001:1.text: It's been a little while since the court mage selection ended.
say:1:1623361001:1.source_cn: 宫廷魔法师的选拔已经结束一段时间了。
say:1:1623361001:1.male: It's been a little while since the court mage selection ended.
say:1:1623361001:1.female: It's been a little while since the court mage selection ended.

say:2:1623361002:1.text: But a few of the ones who didn't make it are still stuck in a slump. That's not great for their training, and if it keeps going, it can turn into a real problem.
say:2:1623361002:1.source_cn: 但有几名落选者始终意志消沉。这种状态不利于他们后续的魔...
say:2:1623361002:1.male: But a few of the ones who didn't make it are still stuck in a slump. That's not great for their training, and if it keeps going, it can turn into a real problem.
say:2:1623361002:1.female: But a few of the ones who didn't make it are still stuck in a slump. That's not great for their training, and if it keeps going, it can turn into a real problem.

say:3:1623361003:1.text: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.
say:3:1623361003:1.source_cn: 得有人帮他们疏导一下情绪。
say:3:1623361003:1.male: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.
say:3:1623361003:1.female: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.

choice_prompt:4:1623361003.text: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.
choice_prompt:4:1623361003.source_cn: 得有人帮他们疏导一下情绪。
choice_prompt:4:1623361003.male: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.
choice_prompt:4:1623361003.female: Someone needs to talk to them and help them sort their heads out.

say:0:1623362001:0.text: Ugh... didn't make it. That's it, I guess.

say:1:1623362002:0.text: Yeah. If I'd known it would end like this, I wouldn't have pushed myself so hard.
say:1:1623362002:0.source_cn: 是啊……早知道还那么努力干嘛

say:1:1623363001:2.text: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.
say:1:1623363001:2.source_cn: 眼前的学生打了个长长的哈欠，睡眼惺忪地望向你。
say:1:1623363001:2.male: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.
say:1:1623363001:2.female: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.

say:4:1623363004:3.text: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!
say:4:1623363004:3.source_cn: 宫廷魔法师选拔开始前，大家熬夜背书、练习咒语，头发都快...
say:4:1623363004:3.male: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!
say:4:1623363004:3.female: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!

say:5:1623363005:1.text: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!
say:5:1623363005:1.source_cn: 现在好了，全泡汤了！我现在听到魔法两个字，心都突突跳！
say:5:1623363005:1.male: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!
say:5:1623363005:1.female: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!

say:6:1623363006:1.text: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."
say:6:1623363006:1.source_cn: 哈啊……落选之后，晚上更是睡不着，满脑子都是未来的一次...
say:6:1623363006:1.male: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."
say:6:1623363006:1.female: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."

say:8:1623363008:1.text: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.
say:8:1623363008:1.source_cn: 他忽然使劲揉了揉眼睛，死死盯着你，睡意全无。
say:8:1623363008:1.male: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.
say:8:1623363008:1.female: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.

say:9:1623363009:2.text: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!
say:9:1623363009:2.source_cn: 你、你、你……你是梅林！梅林老师？！
say:9:1623363009:2.male: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!
say:9:1623363009:2.female: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!

say:10:1623363010:1.text: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.
say:10:1623363010:1.source_cn: “梅林”这个名字像一道清醒咒，瞬间驱散了周围的消极氛围。
say:10:1623363010:1.male: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.
say:10:1623363010:1.female: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.

say:11:1623363011:1.text: The students who were slouching a second ago rush over, eyes bright.
say:11:1623363011:1.source_cn: 原本东倒西歪的学生们一下全围了过来，眼睛闪闪发光。

say:13:1623363012:1.text: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!
say:13:1623363012:1.source_cn: 梅林！是梅林老师本人！我是不是还在做梦？！
say:13:1623363012:1.male: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!
say:13:1623363012:1.female: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!

say:14:1623363013:1.text: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.
say:14:1623363013:1.source_cn: 梅林老师，机会难得，我们能不能……跟您切磋一下？！就当...
say:14:1623363013:1.male: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.
say:14:1623363013:1.female: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.

say:15:1623363014:1.text: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
say:15:1623363014:1.source_cn: 和传奇大魔法师切磋魔法技巧……女神啊，我一定能学到超多...
say:15:1623363014:1.male: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
say:15:1623363014:1.female: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!

choice_prompt:16:1623363014.text: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.source_cn: 和传奇大魔法师切磋魔法技巧……女神啊，我一定能学到超多的知识！
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.male: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.female: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!

say:17:1623363015:4.text: The students explode with excitement. They all but trip over each other as they rush over, their eyes bright again with that eager look.
say:17:1623363015:4.source_cn: 学生们瞬间沸腾，争先恐后地围拢上来，眼中重燃热切的光彩。

say:18:1623363016:1.text: Cheers burst out right away. The young mages crack their knuckles, shake out their hands, and start lining up like they can't wait another second.
say:18:1623363016:1.source_cn: 现场立刻爆发出欢呼，年轻人们摩拳擦掌，迫不及待地准备迎...

choice:3:0:1.text: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?
choice:3:0:1.male: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?
choice:3:0:1.female: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?

say:20:1623363003:2.text: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!
say:20:1623363003:2.source_cn: 呃……你倒是比我还心直口快！
say:20:1623363003:2.male: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!
say:20:1623363003:2.female: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!

choice:3:1:2.text: You all look like you haven't slept for days.
choice:3:1:2.male: You all look like you haven't slept for days.
choice:3:1:2.female: You all look like you haven't slept for days.

say:1:1623364001:3.text: This is the best day ever! I'm never forgetting this!
say:1:1623364001:3.source_cn: 太棒了！我会永远记着这个时刻！
say:1:1623364001:3.male: This is the best day ever! I'm never forgetting this!
say:1:1623364001:3.female: This is the best day ever! I'm never forgetting this!

say:3:1623364002:1.text: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...
say:3:1623364002:1.source_cn: 梅林老师……如果您不介意，我、我想用幻象术把刚才的切磋...
say:3:1623364002:1.male: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...
say:3:1623364002:1.female: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...

choice_prompt:4:1623364002.text: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...
choice_prompt:4:1623364002.source_cn: 梅林老师……如果您不介意，我、我想用幻象术把刚才的切磋记录下来，回去好好研究您的施法技巧……
choice_prompt:4:1623364002.male: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...
choice_prompt:4:1623364002.female: Professor Merlin... if you don't mind, could I record that with an illusion spell? I want to watch it back later and really study how you cast...

say:6:1623364004:1.text: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.
say:6:1623364004:1.source_cn: 梅林老师！我刚才……刚才那些话……唉，我不是那个意思……
say:6:1623364004:1.male: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.
say:6:1623364004:1.female: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.

choice_prompt:7:1623364004.text: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.
choice_prompt:7:1623364004.source_cn: 梅林老师！我刚才……刚才那些话……唉，我不是那个意思……
choice_prompt:7:1623364004.male: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.
choice_prompt:7:1623364004.female: Professor Merlin, about what I said earlier... I didn't mean it like that.

say:8:1623364005:1.text: Yeah... you're right. If we failed this time, there's next time. And even if we never become court mages, there are other paths we can take!
say:8:1623364005:1.source_cn: 是的……这次落选了还有下次，不做宫廷魔法师，也还有别的...
say:8:1623364005:1.male: Yeah... you're right. If we failed this time, there's next time. And even if we never become court mages, there are other paths we can take!
say:8:1623364005:1.female: Yeah... you're right. If we failed this time, there's next time. And even if we never become court mages, there are other paths we can take!

say:10:1623364008:1.text: Professor... thank you for practicing with us!
say:10:1623364008:1.source_cn: 老师，谢谢你……能陪我们练习魔法！
say:10:1623364008:1.male: Professor... thank you for practicing with us!
say:10:1623364008:1.female: Professor... thank you for practicing with us!

say:11:1623364009:1.text: Alright, I'm doing it! Tonight I'm going back to the basics. That spar just showed me I've been skipping stuff I shouldn't have!
say:11:1623364009:1.source_cn: 决定了！今晚我要重读基础理论！刚才和您切磋时，我发现自...
say:11:1623364009:1.male: Alright, I'm doing it! Tonight I'm going back to the basics. That spar just showed me I've been skipping stuff I shouldn't have!
say:11:1623364009:1.female: Alright, I'm doing it! Tonight I'm going back to the basics. That spar just showed me I've been skipping stuff I shouldn't have!

say:12:1623364010:1.text: With your guidance, the students quickly rediscover their passion for magic. Now it's time to bring the good news to Professor Zorya.
say:12:1623364010:1.source_cn: 在你的指导之下，学生们重新燃起了对魔法的热情。是时候回...
say:12:1623364010:1.male: With your guidance, the students quickly rediscover their passion for magic. Now it's time to bring the good news to Professor Zorya.
say:12:1623364010:1.female: With your guidance, the students quickly rediscover their passion for magic. Now it's time to bring the good news to Professor Zorya.

choice:7:0:1.text: Magic shouldn't be reduced to one exam.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 魔法不该被一次选拔定义
choice:7:0:1.male: Magic shouldn't be reduced to one exam.
choice:7:0:1.female: Magic shouldn't be reduced to one exam.

say:14:1623364006:1.text: That actually takes me back. When I learned my first spell as a kid, my heart was racing like crazy...
say:14:1623364006:1.source_cn: 这话让我想起小时候学会第一个魔法时，那种心跳加速的感觉……
say:14:1623364006:1.male: That actually takes me back. When I learned my first spell as a kid, my heart was racing like crazy...
say:14:1623364006:1.female: That actually takes me back. When I learned my first spell as a kid, my heart was racing like crazy...

say:15:1623364007:1.text: Somewhere along the way, magic stopped being... magic. It became scores, rankings, and a ticket to a job...
say:15:1623364007:1.source_cn: 可不知道从什么时候开始，魔法好像就变成了分数、排名和求...
say:15:1623364007:1.male: Somewhere along the way, magic stopped being... magic. It became scores, rankings, and a ticket to a job...
say:15:1623364007:1.female: Somewhere along the way, magic stopped being... magic. It became scores, rankings, and a ticket to a job...

choice:7:1:2.text: Magic's about exploring and getting better.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 魔法的意义在于探索与成长
choice:7:1:2.male: Magic's about exploring and getting better.
choice:7:1:2.female: Magic's about exploring and getting better.

say:1:1623365001:1.text: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.
say:1:1623365001:1.source_cn: 看来我可以放心了，因为你脸上挂着满足的笑容。
say:1:1623365001:1.male: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.
say:1:1623365001:1.female: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.

choice_prompt:2:1623365001.text: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.
choice_prompt:2:1623365001.source_cn: 看来我可以放心了，因为你脸上挂着满足的笑容。
choice_prompt:2:1623365001.male: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.
choice_prompt:2:1623365001.female: Alright, I can finally stop worrying. That smile on your face says it all.

say:3:1623365002:1.text: Those selections are brutal. Most people go in hopeful and walk out feeling crushed.
say:3:1623365002:1.source_cn: “选拔”这件事，对绝大多数参与者而言本就是一种残酷的竞争。
say:3:1623365002:1.male: Those selections are brutal. Most people go in hopeful and walk out feeling crushed.
say:3:1623365002:1.female: Those selections are brutal. Most people go in hopeful and walk out feeling crushed.

say:4:1623365003:1.text: Still, maybe this is the shove they needed. Helps them figure out what they actually want, and remember why they picked up magic in the first place.
say:4:1623365003:1.source_cn: 希望这次挫折能让他们看清自己的内心，找回最初学习魔法的热情。
say:4:1623365003:1.male: Still, maybe this is the shove they needed. Helps them figure out what they actually want, and remember why they picked up magic in the first place.
say:4:1623365003:1.female: Still, maybe this is the shove they needed. Helps them figure out what they actually want, and remember why they picked up magic in the first place.

say:5:1623365004:1.text: Thank you for what you've done, Merlin.
say:5:1623365004:1.male: Thank you for what you've done, Merlin.
say:5:1623365004:1.female: Thank you for what you've done, Merlin.
